snippet.title: Ra Ra BOOM Release Date Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Four-player co-op is coming to your couch on August 12! Get ready for Ra Ra BOOM next month on Xbox, PS5, Steam, and EGS this summer. Wishlist now. And play the first two levels on Steam today!

Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/ra-ra-boom/9PLJHRNXP2ZH
PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10014543
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2335060/RA_RA_BOOM/
EGS: https://store.epicgames.com/p/ra-ra-boom-643322
